```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

col_types - specifies the data type(class) that R should assign each column cols() - tells R the type of information each column has e.g. logical, character etc

```{r}
combined_data <- read_csv("combined_gene_data.csv",
                          col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
                          )
glimpse(combined_data)
View(combined_data)
nrow(combined_data)

```

# SOP checklist

```{r}
mouse_life_stage_ok <- c("E9.5", "E12.5", "E15.5", "E18.5",
            "Early adult", "Late adult", "Middle aged adult")

lacz_values_ok <- c ("No data", "ambiguous", "expression", "imageOnly",
              "no expression", "tissue not available")

# normalise the values 
norm <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_lower(x)
  str_replace_all(x, "[^a-z0-9]", "") # any character that is not lowercase letter/ digit delete it and replace it with an empty text
}
  
match_to_sop <- function(x, ok) {
  ok[match(norm(x), norm(ok))]
}


cols5 <- c("gene_accession_id", "p_value", "mouse_life_stage",
          "lacz_eye", "lacz_lung")
```

# audit

```{r}
# count the missing values within the 5 columns 
colSums(is.na(combined_data[cols5])) 

count(combined_data, mouse_life_stage, sort = TRUE) 
count(combined_data, lacz_eye, sort = TRUE) 
count(combined_data, lacz_lung, sort = TRUE)
 
```

# Clean columns

check which values don't match the sop match to sop - compare the dataset values against the approved sop values count - see how many times each unmatched values appear and sort the results from most frequent to least frequent value unmatched values - values that cannot be matched to the approved SOP values

```{r}
# Check for unmatched values 
combined_data |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(mouse_life_stage), 
    is.na(match_to_sop(mouse_life_stage, mouse_life_stage_ok))
  ) |> 
  count(mouse_life_stage, sort = TRUE)
```

0 - all the non - missing values could be matched

#Standarise

```{r}
combined_data <- combined_data |> 
  mutate(
    mouse_life_stage = match_to_sop(
      mouse_life_stage,
      mouse_life_stage_ok
    )
  )

count(combined_data, mouse_life_stage, sort = TRUE)
```

# Check missing values

```{r}
sum(is.na(combined_data$mouse_life_stage))
```

# lacz_eye column

```{r}
# check for the unmatched values in lacz_eye 
combined_data |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(lacz_eye),
    is.na(match_to_sop(lacz_eye, lacz_values_ok))
  ) |> 
  count(lacz_eye, sort = TRUE)

# Standarise
combined_data <- combined_data |> 
  mutate(
    lacz_eye = match_to_sop(
      lacz_eye,
      lacz_values_ok
    )

count(combined_data, lacz_eye, sort = TRUE)
sum(is.na(combined_data$lacz_eye))
```


# p value

```{r}
combined_data |> 
  mutate(p_value_num = as.numeric(p_value)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(p_value), is.na(p_value_num)) |> 
  count(p_value, sort = TRUE)

# Identify values outside the SOP range 
combined_data |> 
  mutate(p_value_num = as.numeric(p_value)) |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(p_value_num),
    p_value_num < 0 | p_value_num > 1
  ) |> 
  count(p_value, sort = TRUE)

combined_data |> 
  filter(as.numeric(p_value) >1)

# identify missing values 
sum(is.na(combined_data$p_value))
```

# Gene accession id

```{r}
combined_data |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(gene_accession_id),
    nchar(gene_accession_id) < 9 |
      nchar(gene_accession_id) > 11
  ) |> 
  count(gene_accession_id, sort = TRUE)

sum(is.na(combined_data$gene_accession_id))
```

filter for 88022

```{r}
combined_data |> 
  filter(gene_accession_id == "88022")

# correct the ID
combined_data <- combined_data |> 
mutate(
  gene_accession_id = if_else(
    gene_accession_id == "88022",
    "MGI:88022",
    gene_accession_id
    )
)

# check the corrected ID
combined_data |> 
  count(gene_accession_id) |> 
  filter(gene_accession_id == "MGI:88022")

combined_data |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(gene_accession_id),
    nchar(gene_accession_id) < 9 |
      nchar(gene_accession_id) > 11
  ) |> 
  count(gene_accession_id, sort = TRUE)

sum(is.na(combined_data$gene_accession_id))
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(combined_data[cols5])) 

count(combined_data, mouse_life_stage, sort = TRUE)
count(combined_data, lacz_eye, sort = TRUE)
count(combined_data, lacz_lung, sort = TRUE)

# check p value range 
combined_data |> 
  mutate(p_value_num = as.numeric(p_value)) |> 
  summarise(
    minimum = min(p_value_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum = max(p_value_num, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```
